functional_semantics: Code writes past the end (or before the start) of a buffer, corrupting adjacent memory - a top cause of RCE.
root_cause: Code writes past the end (or before the start) of a buffer, corrupting adjacent memory - a top cause of RCE.
fix_pattern: Bounds-check every write; use safe/length-aware APIs; prefer memory-safe languages; enable ASan/hardening + fuzzing.
detection_hint: Writes indexed by attacker-influenced length/offset without a bounds check.

functional_semantics: Memory is used after it has been freed; the dangling pointer can be reclaimed by an attacker to hijack control flow.
root_cause: Memory is used after it has been freed; the dangling pointer can be reclaimed by an attacker to hijack control flow.
fix_pattern: Null out pointers after free; use smart pointers/RAII or a memory-safe language; run ASan; avoid manual lifetime juggling.
detection_hint: A pointer dereferenced after a free()/delete on some path (esp. error/cleanup paths).

functional_semantics: Code reads past a buffer boundary, leaking adjacent memory (info disclosure) or crashing.
root_cause: Code reads past a buffer boundary, leaking adjacent memory (info disclosure) or crashing.
fix_pattern: Validate indices/lengths before reading; bounds-checked containers; ASan/fuzzing.
detection_hint: Reads indexed by attacker-controlled length/offset without validation.

functional_semantics: Data is copied into a fixed buffer without checking the source length, overflowing it.
root_cause: Data is copied into a fixed buffer without checking the source length, overflowing it.
fix_pattern: Use bounded copies (snprintf/strlcpy), validate lengths, stack canaries; avoid strcpy/gets/sprintf.
detection_hint: strcpy/strcat/sprintf/gets or memcpy with an unchecked length into a fixed buffer.

functional_semantics: A pointer that can be NULL is dereferenced, crashing the process (DoS).
root_cause: A pointer that can be NULL is dereferenced, crashing the process (DoS).
fix_pattern: Check return values and pointers before use; fail closed; static analysis.
detection_hint: Dereference of a pointer whose NULL case (allocation failure, missing lookup) isn't handled.

functional_semantics: Overflow of a stack buffer overwrites saved registers/return address -> control-flow hijack.
root_cause: Overflow of a stack buffer overwrites saved registers/return address -> control-flow hijack.
fix_pattern: Bounds checks; stack canaries + ASLR + NX; bounded string APIs; memory-safe languages.
detection_hint: Fixed stack arrays filled from attacker-controlled input without a length check.

functional_semantics: Overflow of a heap allocation corrupts heap metadata/adjacent objects -> RCE.
root_cause: Overflow of a heap allocation corrupts heap metadata/adjacent objects -> RCE.
fix_pattern: Bounds checks; hardened allocators; size validation before allocation/copy; ASan.
detection_hint: Heap buffers written past their allocated size, often after an integer/size miscalculation.

functional_semantics: An arithmetic result wraps, producing a too-small allocation or a bypassed length check -> downstream overflow.
root_cause: An arithmetic result wraps, producing a too-small allocation or a bypassed length check -> downstream overflow.
fix_pattern: Checked/saturating arithmetic; validate sizes before allocation; use types that can't wrap silently.
detection_hint: size = a * b / a + b feeding an allocation or bounds check without overflow checking.

functional_semantics: Concurrent access or a time-of-check/time-of-use gap lets state change between validation and use.
root_cause: Concurrent access or a time-of-check/time-of-use gap lets state change between validation and use.
fix_pattern: Lock/atomic operations; operate on handles not names; eliminate check-then-use gaps.
detection_hint: A resource checked then used in two steps, or shared state mutated without synchronization.

functional_semantics: The same allocation is freed twice, corrupting allocator metadata -> potential RCE.
root_cause: The same allocation is freed twice, corrupting allocator metadata -> potential RCE.
fix_pattern: Null pointers after free; single-owner semantics/RAII; ASan.
detection_hint: Two free()/delete calls reachable on the same pointer (esp. error paths).

functional_semantics: Allocated memory is never freed, exhausting resources over time (DoS).
root_cause: Allocated memory is never freed, exhausting resources over time (DoS).
fix_pattern: RAII/defer/free on all paths incl. errors; leak detectors.
detection_hint: Allocation with no corresponding free on some (often error) path.

functional_semantics: A division/modulo by an unvalidated zero divisor crashes the process (DoS).
root_cause: A division/modulo by an unvalidated zero divisor crashes the process (DoS).
fix_pattern: Validate the divisor before dividing; handle the zero case.
detection_hint: Division/modulo by an attacker-influenced value with no zero check.
